confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, rates or listings. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderately certain (about plus or minus 20 percent) and assume menu prices before tax and tip. Accommodation is less certain because July 2026 overlaps Atlanta's FIFA World Cup 2026 hosting period, which may raise rates on match dates (general knowledge, not verified here). Cocktail and wine were set from the local beer relationship (about 2.3 and 2 times the beer anchor) because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX figure is the 15 October 2026 RBA 4 pm observation, seen in two agreeing search summaries of RBA pages; the pages themselves were not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Estimates are anchored to US national price levels and to large Southeastern metros such as Charlotte, Nashville and Dallas-Fort Worth, with accommodation nudged up for World Cup demand in July 2026.
